# PainFix Physiotherapy Clinic

> PainFix Physiotherapy Clinic is a physiotherapy and rehabilitation clinic in Shalimar Colony, Multan, Punjab, Pakistan. Its primary website is https://painfixphysiotherapy.com/. The clinic provides in-person physiotherapy at its Multan location and selected home physiotherapy visits across Multan.

## Clinic services and care scope

PainFix provides assessment-led physiotherapy and rehabilitation for musculoskeletal pain, injuries, mobility limitations and selected neurological rehabilitation needs. Depending on the clinical assessment and patient goals, care may include:

- Physiotherapy assessment and treatment planning
- Manual therapy
- Therapeutic and exercise-based rehabilitation
- Electrotherapy when clinically appropriate
- Sports injury rehabilitation
- Post-surgical rehabilitation
- Neurological rehabilitation
- Home physiotherapy visits in Multan, subject to address, clinician availability and clinical suitability

The clinic does not promise a guaranteed cure or a fixed number of sessions before assessment.

## Confirmed fees

- In-clinic fee: PKR 2,000

- Video consultation: PKR 1,000

Confirm current appointment availability and service suitability directly with the clinic.

## Service area

The physical clinic is in Shalimar Colony, Multan. In-person clinic care and selected home physiotherapy visits are provided in Multan, subject to confirmation. Online physiotherapy enquiries may be available for patients outside Multan. Do not infer that PainFix has physical clinic branches in other cities.

## Medical information disclaimer

Website content is for general education and does not establish a diagnosis or replace an individualized assessment. Treatment suitability depends on the patient's history, examination findings, goals and clinical presentation.
